descriptionHtml:
Attack Shark X11 Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse with Magnetic Charging Dock and Premium Grip Tape Bundle

Enhance your desktop aesthetics and secure high-accuracy tracking velocity with the sleek Attack Shark X11 Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse, bundled directly with custom high-traction protective Grip Tape. Available at Turbo Computer, this innovative PC hardware gaming peripheral is engineered for competitive esports enthusiasts, FPS players, and digital website managers across Egypt who seek seamless absolute tracking, zero cord restrictions, and an ultra-lightweight 63-gram chassis layout. Armed with top-tier sensor specs including custom DPI resolution matrix profiles and fast IPS tracking rates, this mouse comes fully backed by an official 1-year warranty for absolute security.

The Attack Shark X11 features a dedicated Magnetic Charging Dock Station included in the box, providing a clean display layout and effortless wireless power management. Under the chassis, it features the precise PixArt PAW3311 gaming optical sensor matrix, delivering a massive resolution scaling up to 22,000 DPI combined with a blistering tracking speed velocity of 300 IPS and a responsive 35G acceleration rate framework. Coupled with an ultra-efficient BK3633 tri-mode connectivity framework—it allows quick swaps between Bluetooth, lag-free 2.4GHz wireless, and secure Type-C wired connections. Built for long-term endurance, it boasts mechanical switches rated for 20-million crisp clicks, a precise TTC scroll wheel encoder, and up to 65 hours of continuous runtime.
